All plume width estimates as well as plume heights throughout this validation phase are derived from a lateral or vertical extent of a specific centerline concentration. For example, the EPIcode estimated plume width at 0.1 km is based on 50% of the centerline concentration at that distance, 38,000 ppm (50% of 76,000 ppm). The plume width estimate at that distance is therefore an estimate of the extent of 38,000 ppm across the centerline. Table 3.3. Comparison of mean widths from Desert Tortoise (DT1, DT2, and DT4). More specifically, factors are defined herein as the ratio of the higher value between modeled and measured concentrations to the lower value. The terms “High” and “Low” are prepended to indicate when a model value is higher or lower than a measured value respectively.
